releaseNotes: Replaced legacy noise reduction with a studio-grade Offline Adaptive Spectral & Voice De-Noise engine (2048/4096-pt 75% Overlap STFT Wiener + Bark Smoothing), featuring Learn Noise Profile, Auto Adaptive live noise-floor tracking, Threshold (-60..0 dB), Reduction (0..30 dB), Smoothing (0..100%), Voice/Dialogue Focus, and clickless Real-Time Live Preview with instant A/B Bypass compare.
